text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: MUL/LND/02/ACQ/24. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/4/2013/D/520. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, As Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/Servitudes which are required for a public purpose:

Description of the land/servitude sought to be acquired:- 1.8820 hectares from the total land depicted as Lot No. 1, 2 and 3 in Paper No. 1, Zone No. 04 of 27.12.2023 dated Plan No. C.P. 820414 prepared by Surveyor General and situated in the village of Mulatiyana and Neralampitiya in the Neralampitiya Grama Niladhari Division in Mulatiyana Divisional Secretary's Division in Matara District, Southern Province. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Diddenipotha Watta Galkaduwa Part; Description of the Land: A garden, permanent building, toilet and scrub with tea and cinnamon; Claimant: Maturata Plantation Ltd; Extent: 1.7235 Hectare.

Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Dangalagewatta; Description of the Land: Chena Mixed cultivation with tea and cinnamon; Claimant: J. J. Abeygunawardhana; Extent: 0.1376 Hectare. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Dangalagewatta; Description of the Land: Scrub; Claimant: J. J. Abeygunawardhana; Extent: 0.0209 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Mulatiyana on the 05th day of June, 2024 at 10.00 a.m., and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th day of May, 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/Servitude the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Vංඇൽඒൺ D. Sൺආൺඋൺ඄඄ඈൽඒ, Divisional Secretary, Mulatiyana. Divisional Secretariat, Mulatiyana. On 11th March, 2024.
